confirmed: XRP is about $1.32 to $1.33 Wednesday evening, roughly flat over 24 hours (CoinGecko −0.2%), about 2.9% lower than 7 days ago and about 11% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 6:03 PM MDT; Kraken last trade $1.3246, 24h range $1.3063 to $1.3429). Bitcoin is near $81,000, barely moved by the Fed decision (CoinDesk, Unchained via Yahoo Finance).

The Fed held rates at 3.75% to 4.00% today in a 10 to 2 vote; Governor Cook and Cleveland Fed President Hammack wanted a 25 bp hike. Chair Warsh said inflation remains elevated and gave no dovish signal, and CME FedWatch odds of a December hike rose to about 83%. Crypto reaction was muted, and the 10-year yield rose to about 5.03% (CoinDesk, Unchained via Yahoo Finance).

Ripple and Coinbase announced today that RLUSD can now be traded and held in the Coinbase app, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Prime, with 1:1 conversion from dollars, and deposits and withdrawals on the XRP Ledger, Base and Ethereum (Ripple, Oct 28). This is about the RLUSD stablecoin, not an XRP listing change.

Moody's rated RLUSD A2 long-term and P-1 short-term on Oct 27, citing reserves mostly in short-term US government assets and cash held at BNY, with a 103% coverage target; it also flagged that holders don't yet have a direct claim on reserves (Moody's, Decrypt, The Block). Ripple separately said it is on track for about a $900M annual product revenue run rate (Ripple, Oct 28), and Garlinghouse said on stage, 'We will never give up on XRP' (U.Today).

BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody: Ripple and BNY announced Oct 27 that BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients. Plans to let BNY clients mint and redeem RLUSD directly, and a tokenized trade finance pilot with C2FO on the XRP Ledger, are still subject to approvals. Reported independently by The Block and Cointelegraph.

C2FO and Ripple will bring settlement for C2FO's new Instant Pay product onto the XRP Ledger, using RLUSD, so suppliers paid early get funds in seconds instead of days (Ripple, Oct 27). Settlement is in RLUSD, not XRP.

Ripple and Robinhood partnership: RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood and is expected in the Robinhood app later in 2026, with no launch date or eligible states announced yet; Robinhood plans institutional settlement in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, also with no start date (Ripple, Cointelegraph, CryptoSlate Oct 28).

Ripple's national trust bank got final OCC approval (announced Oct 26). It will manage RLUSD reserves and offer business custody; it cannot take deposits or make loans. Treasury Secretary Bessent appeared with Garlinghouse at Swell on Oct 27 and spoke about stablecoins and dollar strength broadly, not XRP specifically.
Polymarket's US app launched 5-minute up/down prediction markets on BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP on Oct 27 (Crypto Briefing). These are short-term bets on price direction, not investment products in XRP.

US spot XRP ETFs had no net flow on Oct 27, after a $3.61M outflow on Oct 26 from Bitwise's fund; cumulative net inflows are about $1.80B and total net assets about $1.47B to $1.50B (SoSoValue via PANews, CryptoETF.today).
Swell's main stage wraps up tomorrow, Oct 29, in New York: Garlinghouse sits down with Bullish CEO Tom Farley, and issuers of the spot XRP funds share a panel (ICObench schedule summary).

Ripple's regular monthly escrow release of up to 1 billion XRP is scheduled for Nov 1 (6 PM MDT Oct 31). This is routine, not new. An XRP Ledger bug fix (fixCleanup3_4_0) is expected to activate about Nov 4 if validator support holds.
not_confirmed: The CLARITY Act has not passed the Senate: the 'Senate Banking Committee advances CLARITY Act 15 to 9' posts recycle a May 14, 2026 vote, and the full Senate then failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15. 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false. 'Whales now control nearly 74% of supply' does not match the latest Santiment figure of about 68.5% for 10M+ XRP wallets. The '3.7 million XRPL transactions in a day' figure is real but is from Oct 25, after an unusually low Oct 24, so it is not new. BlackRock's appearance at Swell is a digital-assets director on an asset-manager panel, not a BlackRock XRP deal; no BlackRock XRP ETF filing or BlackRock–Ripple deal exists. No outlet confirms the '$60 billion in XRP transfers overnight' or 'Trump met with Ripple' posts. Ripple is not releasing 1.3 billion XRP on Nov 1. 'Binance XRP open interest CRASHED 28%' posts describe a real CryptoQuant figure, but it is a decline over five weeks (since Sept 22), partly because XRP's price fell, not a sudden crash today. Price 'what if' posts are speculation with no source. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins or message-me-for-a-guide offers fit common scam patterns. Details are in the rumors section.

news.headline: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged, as expected
news.summary: The Fed held its range at 3.75% to 4.00%. Bitcoin edged up to about $81,000 and the 10-year Treasury yield rose about 4 bp to 5.025%.

news.headline: Bitcoin shrugs off a hawkish Fed as volatility bets barely budge
news.summary: 10 to 2 vote with Cook and Hammack dissenting for a hike; Warsh offered no dovish signal. December hike odds rose to about 82.6% (CME FedWatch); bitcoin options volatility was essentially unchanged.

news.headline: Ripple and Coinbase Partner to Expand Access to Ripple USD
news.summary: RLUSD is live on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and the Coinbase app with 1:1 dollar conversion; deposits and withdrawals on XRPL, Base and Ethereum. International exchange support, including use as collateral, comes later.

news.headline: Ripple reports banner year approaching $900M annual product revenue run rate
news.summary: Ripple's own Swell kickoff release: on track to exit 2026 at about $900M annualized product revenue, with 1,700+ institutional customers. Company-reported figures, not audited.

news.headline: Moody's assigns investment-grade ratings to Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin
news.summary: A2 long-term and P-1 short-term deposit ratings for RLUSD issued by Ripple's Standard Custody & Trust Co.; reserves mostly T-bills and cash at BNY with a 103% coverage target.

news.headline: Moody's rates Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD stablecoin A2, a day after OCC bank approval
news.summary: Notes Moody's caveats: the issuer is not bankruptcy-remote and holders lack a direct ownership interest in reserves today; the GENIUS Act taking effect in 2027 would address that. The rating was requested by the issuer.

news.headline: 'We Will Never Give Up on XRP': Ripple CEO Ends Speculations
news.summary: At the Swell main stage, Garlinghouse pushed back on claims Ripple is abandoning XRP for RLUSD, calling the two complementary.

news.headline: XRP Open Interest Falls 28% on Binance to $445 Million by Oct. 27
news.summary: CryptoQuant's Darkfost: Binance XRP futures open interest fell 28% since Sept 22, below its 180-day average, partly from the lower price and liquidations. Analysts call it deleveraging; past-pattern rebound talk is not a forecast.

news.headline: Robinhood links 29 million app users to Ripple's XRP Ledger
news.summary: Careful read of the Robinhood deal: RLUSD in the Robinhood app is expected later in 2026 with no date or eligible jurisdictions announced, and planned XRP Ledger settlement has no start date. The '29 million users' headline is Robinhood's user base, not users of XRPL today.

news.headline: C2FO and Ripple Partner to Modernize Trade Finance Using the XRP Ledger
news.summary: Financing and settlement for C2FO Instant Pay will run on the XRP Ledger using RLUSD. Ripple says RLUSD is over $2.5B in market cap, with more than $1B issued on XRPL.

news.headline: Polymarket US launches 5-minute crypto up or down markets
news.summary: The CFTC-regulated Polymarket US app added 5-minute up/down markets for BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP, settled by Chainlink's 60-second average price. These are short-term bets, not exposure to XRP itself.

news.headline: Ripple Expands Strategic Digital Assets Collaboration with BNY Across Custody and Tokenized Trade Finance
news.summary: BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD. Planned RLUSD mint and redeem through BNY and XRPL trade finance work with C2FO are subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals.

news.headline: Ripple, BNY explore using the XRP Ledger to finance approved invoices
news.summary: Independent report on the BNY custody expansion and the C2FO pilot; notes the companies have not said when the proposed services and trade finance applications will launch.

news.headline: Ripple, Robinhood expand partnership to bring RLUSD to retail and institutional markets
news.summary: RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, coming to the Robinhood app later this year; Robinhood adopts Ripple Treasury. C2FO told Cointelegraph its Instant Pay service is in testing, with first RLUSD transactions on XRPL expected by year-end.

news.headline: Ripple and Robinhood Partner to Power the Next Generation of Finance
news.summary: Ripple's own announcement of the Robinhood deal across RLUSD, Ripple Treasury and Ripple Prime.

news.headline: Bessent: stablecoins will help ensure dollar dominance
news.summary: At Swell, the Treasury Secretary told Garlinghouse that dollar-backed stablecoins could become an important source of demand for Treasuries, and predicted guardrails against debanking crypto firms.

news.headline: Scott Bessent puts crypto alongside AI and chips in U.S.-China tech race at Ripple conference
news.summary: Bessent framed digital assets as part of a technology contest with China that could fortify the dollar; he did not discuss XRP specifically.

news.headline: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
news.summary: Independent report on the OCC approval: the bank will manage RLUSD reserves and provide regulated custody, while RLUSD stays issued by Ripple's New York-regulated trust company. RLUSD is about $2.5B in market value, with most reserves held at BNY.

news.headline: XRP Whales Now Control Most Supply Since 2022
news.summary: On-chain data firm Santiment says wallets with 10M+ XRP hold about 46.87B XRP (about 68.5% of supply), the highest share since November 2022. It is a wallet-size metric and the firm's own interpretation; it does not identify owners.

news.headline: BlackRock, SBI Holdings and Startale sign MOU to bridge tokenized money market funds and yen stablecoin (JPYSC)
news.summary: An exploratory agreement to study linking BlackRock's tokenized money market funds with SBI's yen stablecoin JPYSC. No product, network or launch date is set. SBI is a long-time Ripple partner, but Ripple and XRP are not part of this agreement.

news.headline: SEC delays GraniteShares 3x Bitcoin, XRP and Ethereum ETFs ahead of US midterms
news.summary: GraniteShares' Oct 26 filing moves the planned effective date of eight proposed 3x long and short daily ETFs, including two XRP funds, to Nov 30. The filing states no reason and is not a rejection. The headline's 'SEC delays' framing overstates it: the issuer filed the delay.

news.headline: Ripple Receives Final OCC Approval to Establish National Trust Bank
news.summary: The OCC granted final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank, after conditional approval in December 2025. It will manage segregated RLUSD reserves, act as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders and offer fiduciary digital asset custody. RLUSD issuance stays with Standard Custody & Trust (NYDFS-regulated).

news.headline: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million of money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
news.summary: Two $75M subscriptions brought Franklin's tokenized money-market fund (sgBENJI) on XRPL to about 193M shares, roughly $200M, all held in one wallet that shares signers with Franklin's issuing account. Who the investors are is undisclosed. These are fund shares, not XRP purchases.

news.headline: Ripple schedules up to 1 billion XRP escrow release for Nov. 1, 2026
news.summary: Routine monthly escrow unlock at 00:00 UTC Nov 1. In October, 700M of the 1B released was re-locked. How much stays out or is sold is not known in advance.

claims.claim: 🚨JUST IN: $XRP open interest on Binance just CRASHED 28%.
claims.who: Many copy-paste XRP accounts on X, Oct 28
claims.check: Real figure, misleading framing. CryptoQuant's data shows Binance XRP open interest down about 28% since Sept 22, to about $445M on Oct 27, partly because XRP's price fell 17% in that time. It is a five-week decline in leverage, not a crash today.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: XRP Open Interest Falls 28% on Binance to $445 Million by Oct. 27

claims.claim: JUST IN: Coinbase expands access to Ripple's $RLUSD stablecoin, supporting trading and transfers across $XRP Ledger, Ethereum and Base
claims.who: SokoData and other accounts on X, Oct 28
claims.check: Confirmed by Ripple's own announcement today. It concerns the RLUSD stablecoin on Coinbase, not XRP itself.
claims.check_title: Ripple: Ripple and Coinbase Partner to Expand Access to Ripple USD

claims.claim: 🚨 JUST IN: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse reaffirms his commitment to $XRP: "WE WILL NEVER GIVE UP ON XRP."
claims.check: Accurate quote from the Swell main stage, reported by U.Today. It is a statement of intent, not a new product or price event.
claims.check_title: U.Today: 'We Will Never Give Up on XRP': Ripple CEO Ends Speculations

claims.claim: BREAKING: Senate Banking Committee advances the CLARITY Act! The committee reportedly passed the bill in a 15–9 vote
claims.check: Recycled. The 15 to 9 committee vote happened on May 14, 2026. The full Senate then failed to advance the bill 49 to 50 on Sept 15, and no new vote is scheduled.
claims.check_title: Roll Call: Senate Banking approves crypto market structure bill (May 2026)

claims.claim: JUST IN: $XRP whales now control nearly 74% of the circulating supply, worth over $61 BILLION
claims.who: STEPH IS CRYPTO on X, Oct 28
claims.check: Doesn't match the latest data: Santiment puts wallets with 10M+ XRP at about 68.5% of supply. The post gives no source for 74%, and wallet size does not identify owners.
claims.check_title: Santiment: XRP Whales Now Control Most Supply Since 2022

claims.claim: BREAKING: XRP Ledger transactions just EXPLODED to 3.7 MILLION in a single day. Wtf is going on???
claims.who: XRP community accounts on X, Oct 28
claims.check: The number is real but old: 3.72M transactions on Oct 25, a six-month high that followed an unusually low 204,582 on Oct 24. It is a transaction count, not money flowing into XRP.
claims.check_title: TokenPost: XRP Ledger Records 3.72 Million Transactions, a Six-Month High

claims.claim: BREAKING: BlackRock [$15.5T in assets] is scheduled to speak at Ripple Swell 2026
claims.check: True but small: BlackRock digital-assets director Max Stein was on an invite-only asset-manager panel on Oct 27 with Ripple, Aviva and New York Life. A panel appearance is not a BlackRock XRP deal or ETF.
claims.check_title: Times Tabloid: The IMF and BlackRock Are Both Speaking At Ripple Swell 2026

claims.claim: BREAKING: CEO of Ripple Brad Garlinghouse on FOX NEWS! Donald Trump had a meeting with Ripple
claims.check: No outlet reports a Trump meeting with Ripple. Treasury Secretary Bessent did appear with Garlinghouse at Swell on Oct 27, which may be the source of the confusion.
claims.check_title: American Banker: Bessent: stablecoins will help ensure dollar dominance

claims.claim: PRESIDENT TRUMP JUST CONFIRMED: FINAL 12-HOUR WARNING: THE RESET IS LIVE. The window to secure your future is slamming shut
claims.check: The same 'final 12-hour warning' has been posted repeatedly for days with nothing happening. Countdown urgency plus 'secure your future' fits a common scam pattern.

claims.claim: JUST IN: BNY Mellon, the world's largest custodian, now supports XRP
claims.check: True: BNY's custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients, per Ripple's release and The Block. It is a custody service; it does not mean BNY is buying XRP. Mainstream-corroborated by crypto press, not yet by general financial press in our search.
claims.check_title: The Block: Ripple, BNY explore using the XRP Ledger to finance approved invoices

claims.claim: JUST IN: Ripple $XRP and Robinhood $HOOD officially announce strategic partnership
claims.who: Watcher.Guru and many copy accounts on X, Oct 27
claims.check: True, though the deal centers on Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin, Ripple Treasury and Ripple Prime rather than XRP. Robinhood will use RLUSD on the XRP Ledger for institutional settlement.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Nearly $60 billion in $XRP transfers recorded overnight. What is going on???
claims.who: 'JAKE XRP COMMUNITY' account on X, Oct 27
claims.check: No data source given and no outlet reports it. The nearest real figures are a $49.66B on-ledger transfer day on Oct 19 (Santiment, via a crypto blog) and nearly $60B in XRP futures volume for all of September. Transfer volume also counts exchange and internal wallet moves, so it is not buying.
claims.check_title: Tangem News: September XRP futures volume near $60 billion

claims.claim: RUMORS: Ripple National Trust Bank will replace the Federal Reserve
claims.who: Circulating on X; debunked by community account XRP Herald, Oct 27
claims.check: False. The OCC charter covers managing RLUSD reserves, acting as collateral trustee and digital asset custody. A trust bank cannot take deposits or make loans, let alone replace the central bank.
claims.check_title: CoinDesk: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank

claims.claim: JUST IN: Trump signs crypto bill into law. If your XRP is on exchanges it's not yours; message 'XRP GUIDE' and I'll show you
claims.check: False. The CLARITY Act failed a Senate cloture vote 49 to 50 on Sept 15 and has not been signed. The 'message me for a wallet guide' pitch fits a common scam pattern; never share keys or move coins at a stranger's direction.
claims.check_title: NPR: Crypto suffers major defeat as Senate rejects Clarity Act

claims.claim: BREAKING: XRP whales now control 68.5% of the supply. Whales keep accumulating around $1.29
claims.who: X Finance Bull and reposts on X, Oct 27
claims.check: The figure is real Santiment data (10M+ XRP wallets hold about 46.87B XRP). 'Accumulating' is Santiment's interpretation; the metric does not show who owns the wallets, and it is not a price signal on its own.
claims.check_title: Santiment: XRP Whales Now Control Most Supply Since 2022

claims.claim: BREAKING: BlackRock signs MOU with Ripple partner SBI Holdings and Startale Group
claims.check: The MOU is real, but it is about linking BlackRock tokenized money market funds with SBI's yen stablecoin. Ripple and XRP are not named in it, so the 'Ripple partner' framing implies a link that isn't there.
claims.check_title: Startale: BlackRock, SBI Holdings and Startale sign MOU

claims.claim: SEC delays new XRP ETF again
claims.who: Coinpedia headline and community reposts, Oct 26 to 27
claims.check: Partly true. GraniteShares itself filed to move the planned effective date of its 3x leveraged XRP funds (and BTC, ETH, SOL ones) to Nov 30. It is not an SEC ruling and has nothing to do with the spot XRP ETFs already trading.

claims.claim: BREAKING: Ripple gets final OCC approval to run a U.S. national trust bank
claims.who: Brad Garlinghouse and many community reposts on X, Oct 26
claims.check: True: Ripple's Business Wire press release says the OCC granted final approval. Some reposts overstate it: it is a fiduciary trust bank for RLUSD reserves and custody, with no deposits or lending, and it is not an XRP purchase or price event.
claims.check_title: Ripple via Business Wire: Ripple Receives Final OCC Approval to Establish National Trust Bank

claims.claim: JUST IN: Aviva Investors launches a tokenized share class of its £22B sterling fund on the XRP Ledger
claims.check: True, and corroborated by mainstream financial press (Financial News). But the £22B is the whole fund; about £86M is in the tokenized classes, and these are fund shares, not XRP purchases.
claims.check_title: Financial News: Aviva Investors steps up digital assets push by tokenising largest fund
